page_title: CAG 3-0 MON | Cagliari v Monza 30/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Francesco Fourneau has blown his whistle and the game is over.

90+2' 3 - 0 Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Stefano Turati is just a bystander as the ball flies into bottom right corner. The score is 3:0.
90+1' The referee awards a corner and Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) goes over to take it.
90+1' A substitution has been made. Tommaso Augello goes off and Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) comes on.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' The corner is swung in but Monza can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

89' Gianluca Caprari (Monza) has a good chance to score with a mid-range attempt after collecting a pass. He aims for the bottom left corner, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Elia Caprile. Corner kick. Monza will have an opportunity.
89' Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Monza) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
88' Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Monza) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
88' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) blows a clear opportunity! He needed only to tap the ball in, but narrowly misses the goal.
85' Gianluca Caprari (Monza) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
82' Alessandro Nesta decides to make a substitution. Dany Mota will be replaced by Andrea Petagna (Monza).
81' Monza failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
76' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Antoine Makoumbou (Cagliari) will replace Matteo Prati.
76' Substitution. Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) replaces Roberto Piccoli.
75' Today's referee Francesco Fourneau rightly decides to book Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) for his harsh tackle.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Georgios Kyriakopoulos trots off the pitch and is replaced by Samuele Vignato (Monza).
74' Alessandro Nesta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Silvere Ganvoula (Monza) replacing Keita Balde.
73' 2 - 0 Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) scores a great goal from the resulting free kick from mid-range. He sends the ball directly inside the left post.
72' The resulting set piece from Cagliari is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
71' Monza take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
71' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Stefano Turati intercepts the ball. The referee signals a corner kick to Cagliari.
70' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) is adjudged offside.
67' Francesco Fourneau shows the yellow card to Keita Balde (Monza) for a heavy challenge.
67' Monza quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
67' Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Monza) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
64' Gianluca Caprari (Monza) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
61' The substitution has been made. Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) has replaced Mattia Felici.
60' Here is a change. Gaetano Castrovilli is going off and Alessandro Nesta gives the last tactical orders to Patrick Ciurria (Monza).
60' Samuele Birindelli will be replaced by Gianluca Caprari (Monza).
60' Here comes a substitution. Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) is brought on as a substitute for Nicolas Viola.
58' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
56' A pass by Michel Adopo (Cagliari) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
54' Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Monza) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
52' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle for an infringement.
50' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Monza.
49' 1 - 0 Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header inside the left post. Excellent finish.
47' A crossfield pass from Matteo Prati (Cagliari) fails to find any of his teammates.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Keita Balde (Monza) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
43' Matteo Prati (Cagliari) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
40' The opposition can't get near Mattia Felici (Cagliari), who finally takes a shot inside the box. The effort looks goalbound but veers just wide of the left post at the last second.
38' Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle after Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
36' Alessandro Bianco (Monza) latches on to a pass on the edge of the box, but he can't get any power into the shot and fails to trouble Elia Caprile.
33' Matteo Prati (Cagliari) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
32' Matteo Prati (Cagliari) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
29' A yellow card for a tackle by Armando Izzo (Monza). Francesco Fourneau doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
28' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Cagliari, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
27' Danilo D'Ambrosio (Monza) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle for a foul. Cagliari are awarded the free kick.
25' Keita Balde (Monza) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
24' The free kick from long range, taken by Monza, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.

22' Mattia Felici (Cagliari) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
22' Stefano Turati (Monza) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
21' Looks like Stefano Turati (Monza) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
20' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) is penalised for a foul. Francesco Fourneau had a clear view and blows his whistle.
20' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) will take a corner kick.
19' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. The ball goes out of play. Cagliari are awarded a corner kick.
18' Neat passing move from Monza in order to create new attacking opportunities.
16' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) is penalised for holding. Francesco Fourneau signals a set piece.
14' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) commits a foul and Francesco Fourneau immediately signals a free kick.
14' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) unleashes a shot from a mid-range free kick that crashes into the defensive wall. The opposition's goalkeeper set it up perfectly.
12' Sebastiano Luperto (Cagliari) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Francesco Fourneau didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
11' Dany Mota (Monza) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit.
10' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) serves up a nice cross, but Elia Caprile punches the ball away.
9' The ball is cleared after Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
7' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) leaps like a salmon to meet a lofted ball into the box, but his header from near the penalty spot fizzes narrowly wide of the right post.
7' Danilo D'Ambrosio (Monza) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
6' Alessandro Bianco (Monza) picks up an injury.
4' Francesco Fourneau has a clear sight and sees a foul from Michel Adopo (Cagliari).
2' The game is interrupted now, Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
1' Pedro Pereira (Monza) makes a rough challenge and Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Monza will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Francesco Fourneau.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
Show lineups
